workflow_metadata.name: Dev-02 Core & Domain Model Realization
workflow_metadata.description: Transform architectural skeleton into concrete code foundations and core domain logic.

llm_context_anchoring._purpose: Prevent LLM context drift during long development tasks
llm_context_anchoring.description: Development tasks are long. LLMs can 'forget' they're executing a Reflow workflow. This section defines checkpoints to re-anchor.

mandatory_context_refresh.description: MANDATORY: Re-read workflow context at start of D-02
actions: READ context/working_memory.json - extract current_workflow, current_step, paths
READ specs/machine/graphs/system_of_systems_graph.json - understand service relationships
READ specs/machine/service_arch/{current_service}/service_architecture.json - understand this service
ACKNOWLEDGE: 'I am executing Reflow workflow D-02 for {service_name}'

checkpoint_frequency.description: Insert context checkpoint every N actions or time threshold

drift_indicators: LLM makes changes without reading SERVICE_CONTRACT.json
LLM adds interfaces not in interface_registry.json
LLM forgets what workflow step it's on when asked

anchor_files.description: Files that should remind LLM of workflow context

steps.description: MANDATORY: Anchor to Reflow workflow context before starting D-02
steps.purpose: Prevent context drift during long development phase
actions: READ context/working_memory.json
READ specs/machine/service_arch/{service}/service_architecture.json
ACKNOWLEDGE: 'I am executing Reflow D-02 for {service_name}. My next validation gate is D-02 exit criteria.'
UPDATE context/dev_current_focus.md with current service and D-02 start
steps.llm_must_state: Before proceeding, state: 'I am starting Reflow D-02 (Core & Domain) for [service_name]. I will checkpoint every 3 actions.'

steps.description: Generate directory skeleton for each service (dependency order)
Create placeholder interface adapters aligning with api_contracts.json
CHECKPOINT: Re-anchor to Reflow workflow after 3 implementation steps
steps.purpose: Prevent tunnel vision - LLM may have lost workflow context while coding
actions: PAUSE current coding task
READ services/{service_name}/SERVICE_CONTRACT.json (if exists)
VERIFY: Am I following the contracted functions?
VERIFY: Have I introduced any new interfaces not in the architecture?
UPDATE context/dev_progress_tracker.json with D2.1, D2.2, D2.3 status
STATE: 'Checkpoint complete. I am on Reflow D-02, next: D2.4 (config loader)'

questions: What Reflow workflow step am I on?
What contracted functions must this service implement?
What is my next validation gate?
drift_check.if_cannot_answer: STOP - Read working_memory.json and SERVICE_CONTRACT.json before continuing

steps.description: CHECKPOINT: Re-anchor before domain logic implementation
steps.purpose: Domain logic is the longest part - anchor before diving in
actions: READ services/{service_name}/SERVICE_CONTRACT.json
LIST contracted functions that need implementation
UPDATE context/dev_current_focus.md: 'Starting domain logic for {service}. Functions: {list}'
STATE: 'Checkpoint complete. Now implementing domain logic. Functions to implement: [list]'

steps.description: Rank use cases and implement domain services (pure logic first)
Wire API handlers to domain services per api_contracts.json
Enforce validation and auth policies per compliance.json
CHECKPOINT: Verify implementation matches architecture before generating contracts
steps.purpose: Last check before contract generation - catch drift early
actions: COMPARE implemented functions vs specs/machine/service_arch/{service}/service_architecture.json
VERIFY: All allocated_functions are implemented
VERIFY: No extra functions added that aren't in architecture
If drift detected: Document in context/dev_current_focus.md for D-06 reconciliation

steps.purpose: Embed architectural contract within service to prevent LLM drift
steps.when: After domain model implementation, before integration surfaces

architecture_validation.description: Validates service architectures match templates and have consistent interfaces
architecture_validation.success_criteria: All service architectures pass validation with no errors

docker_compose_integration.tool: docker-compose up --build -d && docker-compose ps && docker-compose down
docker_compose_integration.description: Verifies all services can start successfully in containerized environment
docker_compose_integration.success_criteria: All services reach 'running' status within startup timeout
validation_steps: Check service health endpoints if available
Collect logs from any failed services

interface_consistency.description: Ensures all service interfaces are properly registered and consistent
checks: All endpoints defined in api_contracts.json are implemented
All interface contracts exist in specs/machine/interfaces/

auto_progress_detection.description: Automatically detect which Dev-02 actions are complete by scanning code

on_validation_failure.message: Cannot proceed to Dev-03. Fix validation issues first.
remediation_steps: Fix identified issues in service code or architecture
Only proceed when all validation gates pass
